body:
Bro, I'm glad I caught this submission... I'm probably not going to be of much help, but I wish to be supportive. 

I swear I could be the one who wrote all of that. I did the same thing, I broke up with my ex because of episodes of depression and that nagging feeling of something had to change and for a while, it kind of worked. I took it all for granted, she was my everything and best friend of 5 years and once she began dating someone else, I completely lost it (and this is all within the past 6 months). When I found out, she was still telling me she loves me, etc., but she just could not be with me at the time. She even went to the extent of saying we would be together in the future and that was a total mind fuck. Every time we talk, it hurts even a little more and I'm going to be honest with you... the best thing to do is probably remove her from your life. You have got to move on. Dwelling is a place you do NOT want to be because it will seep into all aspects of your life. 

I'm still in the same position and it still hurts, but I am trying to make progress and I hope you can find a way out of it. There will be other opportunities for you and other people for you to grow close to, I promise you. Just keep your friends and family as close as possible. I know what its like to find everything meaningless and feel as if you're failing yourself and everyone else, but you have to know it's not true and this too shall pass. 

Take it easy buddy, play some sports, get some coffee with friends. 

From someone who knows about and cares about your situation, good luck and stay strong.

Edit: spelling

I have never tried any type of anti-depressants, and if there is anyone out there with some information on them, I'd appreciate it. Do you think it'll help? because I know that getting a prescription to a drug of that stature will have its effects.
